items.source: Adds a RepositoryMethodInvocationListener to the factory to plug in functionality triggered right after running query methods and fragment methods.
items.translation: 向工厂添加一个RepositoryMethodInvocationListener，用于在运行查询方法和片段方法之后立即触发功能。

items.source: Returns the QueryLookupStrategy for the given QueryLookupStrategy.Key and ValueExpressionDelegate.
items.translation: 返回给定QueryLookupStrategy和QueryLookupStrategy.Key以及ValueExpressionDelegate的实例。

items.source: Returns the RepositoryInformation for the given RepositoryMetadata and custom RepositoryComposition.RepositoryFragments.
items.translation: 返回给定 RepositoryMetadata 和自定义 RepositoryComposition.RepositoryFragments 的 RepositoryInformation。

items.source: Adds a QueryCreationListener to the factory to plug in functionality triggered right after creation of RepositoryQuery instances.
items.translation: 向工厂添加一个 QueryCreationListener，用于在创建RepositoryQuery实例后立即触发功能。

items.source: Returns the EntityInformation for the given RepositoryMetadata.
items.translation: 返回给定RepositoryMetadata的EntityInformation。

items.source: Creates RepositoryComposition.RepositoryFragments based on RepositoryMetadata to add repository-specific extensions.
items.translation: 根据 RepositoryMetadata 创建 RepositoryComposition.RepositoryFragments，以添加特定于存储库的扩展。

items.source: Configures a NamedQueries instance to be handed to the QueryLookupStrategy for query creation.
items.translation: 配置一个 NamedQueries 实例，以便将其传递给 QueryLookupStrategy 用于查询创建。

items.source: since 4.0, use getEntityInformation(RepositoryMetadata) instead.
items.translation: 自 4.0 版本起，请使用getEntityInformation(RepositoryMetadata)。

items.source: Returns a ProjectionFactory instance.
items.translation: 返回一个ProjectionFactory实例。

items.source: Returns the ProjectionFactory to be used with the repository instances created.
items.translation: 返回用于与创建的仓库实例配合使用的ProjectionFactory。

items.source: Returns the RepositoryMetadata for the given repository interface.
items.translation: 返回给定存储库接口的RepositoryMetadata。

items.source: Creates a repository of the repository base class defined in the given RepositoryInformation using reflection.
items.translation: 使用反射创建由给定RepositoryInformation定义的存储库基类的存储库。

items.source: Sets the EvaluationContextProvider to be used to evaluate SpEL expressions in manually defined queries.
items.translation: 设置用于在手动定义的查询中评估 SpEL 表达式的EvaluationContextProvider。

items.source: Create an instance of the repository base class providing store-specific built-in repository functionality of a typical CrudRepository.
items.translation: 创建一个存储库基类的实例，提供典型CrudRepository的特定于存储的内置存储库功能。

items.source: Convenience method to instantiate a class using the given constructorArguments by looking up a matching constructor.
items.translation: 使用给定的 constructorArguments 查找匹配的构造函数，从而实例化类的便捷方法。

items.source: Returns a repository instance for the given interface.
items.translation: 返回给定接口的仓库实例。

items.source:
Returns a repository instance for the given interface backed by an instance providing implementation logic for
custom logic.
items.translation: 返回一个仓库实例，该实例由提供自定义逻辑实现的后端支持，并对应给定的接口。

items.source: Sets the strategy of how to look up a query to execute finders.
items.translation: 设置查找查询执行策略。

items.source: Default is false, in order to avoid unnecessary extra interception. This means that no guarantees are provided that RepositoryMethodContext access will work consistently within any method of the advised object.
items.translation: 默认值为 false，以避免不必要的额外拦截。这意味着无法保证在任何被建议对象的任何方法中都能一致地访问RepositoryMethodContext。

items.source:
Note that this method tries to set the constructor accessible if given a non-accessible (that is, non-public)
constructor, and supports Kotlin classes with optional parameters and default values.
items.translation: 请注意，此方法会尝试将非可访问（即非公共）的构造函数设为可访问；同时，它也支持带有可选参数和默认值的 Kotlin 类。

items.source: Adds RepositoryProxyPostProcessors to the factory to allow manipulation of the ProxyFactory before the proxy gets created. Note that the QueryExecutorMethodInterceptor will be added to the proxy after the RepositoryProxyPostProcessors are considered.
items.translation: 向工厂添加RepositoryProxyPostProcessor，以便在创建代理之前对ProxyFactory进行操纵。请注意，QueryExecutorMethodInterceptor将在考虑完RepositoryProxyPostProcessors之后添加到代理中。

items.source: Adds RepositoryProxyPostProcessors to the factory to allow manipulation of the ProxyFactory before the proxy gets created.
items.translation: 向工厂添加 RepositoryProxyPostProcessor，以便在创建代理之前对 ProxyFactory 进行操纵。

items.source: Factory bean to create instances of a given repository interface. Creates a proxy implementing the configured repository interface and apply an advice handing the control to the QueryExecutorMethodInterceptor. Query detection strategy can be configured by setting QueryLookupStrategy.Key.
items.translation: 工厂 Bean 用于创建给定存储库接口的实例。它创建一个实现配置存储库接口的代理，并应用一个顾问，将控制权交给 `QueryExecutorMethodInterceptor`。查询检测策略可以通过设置 QueryLookupStrategy.Key 进行配置。

items.source: Configures the repository base class to use when creating the repository. If not set, the factory will use the type returned by getRepositoryBaseClass(RepositoryMetadata) by default.
items.translation: 配置创建仓库时使用的仓库基类。如果未设置，工厂将默认使用getRepositoryBaseClass(RepositoryMetadata)返回的类型。

items.source: Returns a repository instance for the given interface backed by a single instance providing implementation logic for custom logic. For more advanced composition needs use getRepository(Class, RepositoryFragments).
items.translation: 返回一个由单个实例提供实现逻辑的仓库实例，该实例支持给定接口并针对自定义逻辑。对于更高级的组合需求，请使用 getRepository(Class, RepositoryFragments)。

items.source: Returns the EntityInformation for the given domain class.
items.translation: 返回给定实体类的EntityInformation。

items.source: Returns the base class backing the actual repository instance. Make sure getTargetRepository(RepositoryInformation) returns an instance of this class.
items.translation: 返回实际存储库实例所依赖的基类。请确保 getTargetRepository(RepositoryInformation) 返回此类的实例。

items.source: Set whether the repository method metadata should be exposed by the repository factory as a ThreadLocal for retrieval via the RepositoryMethodContext class.
items.translation: 设置是否将仓库方法元数据作为 ThreadLocal 由仓库工厂暴露，以便通过RepositoryMethodContext类进行检索。
